sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Opaque continuous dark grey/brown painted background fills every canvas edge; no card, frame, backing strip or note. Single male bust turned toward screen-right with a stern closed mouth and light eyes directed sideways toward the viewer; upper-left light. Brown/tan fedora with wide dark brown band and sloping brim, crown cut at the top crop. Short dark brown hair/sideburn patches show below the hat; dark hair eyebrows. Very distinct broad dark handlebar moustache with lighter grey outward-curled tips; clean chin/jaw below it, no glasses. Deep reddish-brown lapelled jacket, tan collared button shirt with no necktie, small pale triangular pocket square at lower screen-left. Original156x210 and nearest4 actually viewed; preserve the original bust crop, tilt, lighting and exact clothing/accessory groups. Original measuredalpha255 throughout.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Complete opaque dark grey painted canvas/background to every edge, no photo card/frame/note. Single male bust facing slightly screen-left, head tilted slightly upward with a serious closed mouth below the moustache and upward eye direction; upper-left illumination. Thick short combed-back side-parted silver-grey hair with high swept top and grey sideburns; dark grey hair eyebrows. Thin dark round spectacles with brown/gold side arms over the eyes. Prominent curled dark/grey handlebar moustache with lighter tips connected to full greying beard along cheeks/chin. Navy dark lapelled suit, pale grey-green pointed collar button shirt without a tie, pale grey triangular pocket square at screen-right. Actual156x210 source plus nearest4 viewed; measuredalpha255 throughout. Tiny shirt/button strokes stay small and are not additional text or insignia.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Complete opaque grey painted rectangular background, no frame/card/overlapping note or exterior cutout. Older male bust in a pronounced screen-right three-quarter head view, with severe closed mouth and a dark smoking pipe held at the screen-right mouth corner: black stem extends right and bends into a small dark brown open bowl. Short neatly combed side-parted brown-grey hair with silver streaks, strong dark hair eyebrows, clean upper lip/chin without a separate moustache/beard. Large thin wire round spectacles sit over the eyes; no hat. Brown knitted V-neck sleeveless vest over pale pink-grey pointed collar shirt and narrow blue/dark tie, with shirt sleeves visible at edges. Upper-left light, original bust crop. Exact156x210 plus nearest4 actually viewed; originalalpha255 throughout.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Solid opaque grey painted background fills the entire rectangular canvas; no card, frame or handwritten note. Single male bust turned slightly toward screen-right with a level serious closed mouth around a thin brown smoking pipe: stem projects to screen-right and ends in a small upturned brown bowl, with a wispy pale grey smoke plume rising above it near the face. Short light-brown/golden hair, neat side part and combed wave, distinct brown hair eyebrows above dark gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses. Clean upper lip and chin, no facial hair or hat. Brown knitted V-neck sleeveless vest, pale pointed shirt collar and dark blue tie, pale shirt sleeve at screen-left edge. Upper-left lighting and original bust framing retained as observed. Exact156x210 and nearest4 actually viewed; originalalpha255 throughout.
